description.value: Restaurant Yugo is a Japanese-French fusion dining destination located on the first floor of The Amazing Brentwood mall in Burnaby, with a sister location in Vancouver. The kitchen blends Japanese technique with French culinary tradition, producing dishes like sashimi with truffle oil, sous-vide endives with yuzu, and confit octopus. Dine-in, takeout, catering, and to-go menus are all offered.
